title: Find the display names of users aged 40 who have posted comments with a sco
question: Find the display names of users aged 40 who have posted comments with a score of 0 on posts that received between 100 and 150 views, and who also have at least one post history entry for a post with 1000 or more views.

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_055" FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_010" INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2."XCL_006" = T3."XCL_026" WHERE T1."XCL_064" = 40 AND T2."XCL_007" = 0 AND T3."XCL_030" BETWEEN 100 AND 150 AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT T4."XCL_017" FROM postHistory AS T4 INNER JOIN posts AS T5 ON T4."XCL_014" = T5."XCL_026" WHERE T5."XCL_030" >= 1000)

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2."XCL_006" = T3."XCL_026"
WHERE T1."XCL_064" = 40
  AND T2."XCL_007" = 0
  AND T3."XCL_030" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory AS T4
    INNER JOIN posts AS T5 ON T4."XCL_014" = T5."XCL_026"
    WHERE T4."XCL_017" = T1."XCL_052"
      AND T5."XCL_030" >= 1000
  )
